title: 第19章 娇贵小公主的典范第20章 修为尽失
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
宁宝儿上前，从储物袋里取出一个药丸递到宁楚唇边，同时伸手将她从地上扶起。
宁楚看着眼前的药丸，知道是品质很好的元气丹，张口咬住，顺势起身。
宁宝儿细心地帮她拍了拍衣裳上的灰尘，语气比之前柔和了许多：“楚楚，对不住，之前是我们多心了。既然查清楚了，那就没什么事了。”
“诶？谁说的？”宁雄霸一拍座椅扶手，“不知楚姑娘师承何门何派？若没拜师，你可愿拜我为师？”
他能看出眼前这个楚楚的根骨极佳，虽然不知为何不能结丹，但天剑宗人多，可以一起帮忙想办法。
待那时，指不定她会变成下一个小师弟那般的天才。
此言一出，宁楚不可置信地抬头看向上首的宁雄霸，拜师？
天剑宗有一个很大的藏书阁，里面藏书无数，说不定有记载无法结丹的原因和办法。
她想留下，但不想拜师。
一提到拜师她就会想到那追随了她一百八十八年的天雷。
可又不好拒绝得太直白。
她思索片刻，抱拳拱手道：“多谢宗主抬爱，晚辈并无师承，只是一介无名散修。”
“但拜师毕竟是件很重要的事，宗主可否容许晚辈考虑几日？”
“当然。”宁雄霸哈哈大笑，他是个爽快人，而且天剑宗家大业大，多养一个人并不是什么大问题。
更何况这个人还是他看好的徒弟。
“宝儿，你带楚楚出去走走逛逛吧，别怠慢了。”
“好，宝儿知道了。”
宁宝儿亲亲热热地挽着宁楚的胳膊，拉着她就要往外走。
可她心中还在想一件事，犹犹豫豫地开口，“宝儿姑娘，不知可否带我去见一见那位被我砸晕的道友？”
“毕竟是因为我才导致他受伤，我心中实在过意不去，想去道个歉。”

宁宝儿脚步一顿，没有立刻回头，而是抬头看向上首的宁雄霸。
父女俩对视一眼，宁雄霸想也没想便摇头，他那小师弟最不喜跟人打交道。
看懂父亲的意思，宁宝儿收回目光，脸上带着一丝歉意，“楚楚，小师叔还没醒，而且小师叔一向不喜跟外人接触。”
“等他醒了，我们会告诉他你的心意，但见面的话……还是算了吧。”
小师叔那一张冰山脸，她都怕楚楚会被吓到。
“那……也行吧。”
他们不让她去看，她就偷偷去看。
反正她又不是不知道鹤隐舟的洞府在哪儿。
宁宝儿带着宁楚在天剑宗各峰闲逛，兴致勃勃地向她介绍着，遇见的弟子都会毕恭毕敬地叫上她一声师姐，足以看出宁宝儿在天剑宗多得人心。
宁楚的目光时不时瞥向藏书阁的方向，她想进去看看有没有帮助结丹的办法，但也清楚的知道藏书阁的规矩。
非天剑宗内门弟子不可进。
她如今是肯定进不去的。
content_en:
Ning Baoer stepped forward, took out a pill from the storage bag and handed it to Ning Chu's lips, while reaching out to help her up from the ground.
Ning Chu looked at the pill in front of him and knew that it was a high-quality Vitality Pill. He opened his mouth to bite it and stood up.
Ning Baoer carefully patted the dust on her clothes, and his tone was much softer than before: "Chu Chu, I'm sorry, we were too worried before. Now that we have found out, it will be fine."
"Eh? Who said that?" Ning Xiongba patted the armrest of the seat, "I wonder what sect Miss Chu studied under? If not, would you like to become my teacher?"
He could see that the Chu Chu in front of him had excellent bones. Although he couldn't form elixirs for some reason, there were many people in the Tianjian Sect and they could help find a solution together.
By then, maybe she will become a genius like the next junior brother.
As soon as he said this, Ning Chu looked up in disbelief at Ning Xiongba, who was looking up to him, to be his disciple?
Tianjian Sect has a large library with countless books, which may contain records of the reasons and methods for not being able to form elixirs.
She wanted to stay, but not become a disciple.
When she mentioned apprenticeship, she would think of Tian Lei who had followed her for 188 years.
But it’s hard to refuse too bluntly.
She thought for a moment, cupped her fists and said, "Thank you so much, Master, for your love. This junior has no master, he is just an unknown casual cultivator."
"But apprenticeship is a very important matter after all. Can the sect master allow this junior to think about it for a few days?"
"Of course." Ning Xiongba laughed loudly. He was a cheerful person, and the Tianjian Sect had a great cause, so raising one more person was not a big problem.
What's more, this person is still his favorite apprentice.
"Bao'er, take Chuchu out for a walk. Don't neglect it."
"Okay, Bao'er knows."
Ning Baoer took Ning Chu's arm affectionately and pulled her out.
But she was still thinking about one thing, and she said hesitantly, "Miss Bao'er, could you take me to see the fellow Taoist who was knocked unconscious by me?"
"After all, it was me who caused him to get hurt. I feel really sorry and want to apologize."
Ning Baoer paused in his steps and did not look back immediately. Instead, he looked up at Ning Xiongba who was looking up.
The father and daughter looked at each other, and Ning Xiongba shook his head without thinking. His junior brother didn't like to deal with people the most.
Understanding what his father meant, Ning Baoer looked away with a hint of apology on his face, "Chu Chu, my junior uncle hasn't woken up yet, and my junior junior uncle never likes to have contact with outsiders."
"When he wakes up, we will tell him your feelings, but if we meet... let's forget it."
She was afraid that Chu Chu would be frightened by the iceberg face of her junior uncle.
"That's okay."
They wouldn't let her go, so she went to see them secretly.
Anyway, it’s not like she didn’t know where He Yinzhou’s cave was.
Ning Baoer took Ning Chu to wander around the peaks of the Tianjian Sect, introducing her to her with great interest. The disciples he met would respectfully call her senior sister, which was enough to show that Ning Baoer was very popular in the Tianjian Sect.
Ning Chu glanced in the direction of the Library Pavilion from time to time. She wanted to go in to see if there was any way to help form pills, but she also clearly knew the rules of the Library Pavilion.
Non-disciples of the inner sect of Tianjian Sect are not allowed to enter.
She definitely can't get in now.
